title: Red or green: 'I'm bad at texting'
caption: 'I'm bad at texting' can mean a lot of things. Round by round.

vis.name: Drew
msgs: heads up, I'm bad at texting

beats.head: ...but texts *everyone else* fine.
beats.sub: Red. That's not a skill issue.

beats.head: ...and *disappears* for a week.
beats.sub: Red. That's not texting. That's absence.

beats.head: Healthy move: *ask what works.*
beats.sub: Calls? Voice notes? Meet in the middle.

beats.head: Send this to someone *'bad at texting.'*
